deep_systems.name: Industrial organizations learn through assigned work
Faction constitutions, shared goals and contribution
Autonomy is a bundle of rights and transfers
Occupation laws require ongoing material support
Resistance, compliance and causal local incidents
Agency departments trade capacity for capabilities
Information networks and targeted access tokens
Scientists have roles, specialties and support work
Leader learning distinguishes practice from appointments
Climate acclimatization is separate from terrain mastery
Raids prepare, launch and resolve distinct consequences
Negotiated settlements use a staged world view
Awards separate service effects from profile milestones
NPC scorers select targets before role-specific designs
Continuous focus is paid maintained intent
